sources.title: AI: Dystopia or Utopia?
sources.quote_checked: AI is different in kind from the previous technological phase changes. | AI will eliminate most "jobs" insofar as a job is defined as a trade or profession | If people work, it will be because they choose to, not because they need to | Universal basic income may be the best equalizer. | Disparity beyond a certain point will lead to social unrest | AI risks are real but manageable. | Falling behind is by far the largest danger that scares me. | Slowing down the development of AI could be disastrous for democracies | a series of technology enabled policy choices and not technology choices | there is need for regulation but no regulation before its time.

sources.title: Legendary Silicon Valley investor Vinod Khosla says the existential risk of sentient AI killing us is 'not worthy of conversation'
sources.quote_checked: The doomers are focusing on the wrong risks. | By far, orders of magnitude, higher risk to worry about, is China, not sentient AI killing us off. | It's sort of not worthy of a conversation to be honest. | We should be worrying about the longer term over the next 25 years, whoever wins the AI race will win the economic race.

sources.title: Despite risks, Vinod Khosla is optimistic about AI
sources.quote_checked: The Sun Microsystems co-founder turned prominent investor. | Khosla Ventures was one of the first institutional investors in OpenAI. | was an easy decision to make | the need to work will go away | all of it can be near free | We could have sentient AI try and kill humanity | the biggest risk we face is strong AI in the hands of our adversaries | Capitalism tends to concentrate wealth, so we have to have policy to equalize it so everybody has a stake.

sources.title: Vinod Khosla on how AI will 'free humanity from the need to work'
sources.quote_checked: This large transformation is the opportunity to free humanity from the need to work. | People will work when they want to work on what they want to work on. | In 25 years, 80% of all jobs will be capable of being done by an AI. | It hurts people, hurts lives, destroys lives. | So you have to have empathy for whoever's being disrupted.

sources.title: This Billionaire Investor in OpenAI and Instacart Says AI Will Be Able to Do 80% of Jobs in 5 Years...
sources.quote_checked: Learning rate above everything else. | Rational people don't do unreasonable things. Building a company is fundamentally unreasonable. | I like to invest in companies that could not have existed five years ago and will be inevitable five years from now. | Is this important? Can it change the world in some meaningful way? | Science projects fail because there is no path. | The roadmap is almost irrelevant.
